Ahl-e-Kitaab ke kuffaar aur deegar mushrikeen apne kufr se alag hone waale nahin the jab tak ke un ke paas khuli daleel na aa jaati
Allah ki taraf ka numaainda jo paakeeza saheefon ki tilaawat kare
Jin mein qeemati aur mazboot baatein likhi hui hain
Aur ye Ahl-e-Kitaab mutafarriq nahin hue magar us waqt jab un ke paas khuli hui daleel aa gayi

Aur unhein sirf is baat ka hukm diya gaya tha ke Khuda ki ibaadat karein aur is ibaadat ko usi ke liye khaalis rakhein aur namaaz qaaim karein aur zakaat ada karein, aur yahi sachcha aur mustahkam deen hai
Be-shak Ahl-e-Kitaab mein jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya hai aur deegar mushrikeen, sab Jahannam mein hamesha rehne waale hain aur yahi badtareen khalaaiq hain
Aur be-shak jo log imaan laaye hain aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain woh behtareen khalaaiq hain

Parwardigar ke yahaan un ki jaza woh baaghaat hain jin ke neeche nehrein jaari hongi, woh unhi mein hamesha rehne waale hain. Khuda un se raazi hai aur woh us se raazi hain, aur ye sab us ke liye hai jis ke dil mein khauf-e-Khuda hai
